release_notes:
RJD PisoWiFi System v3.14.37 - Hardware ID In-Memory Caching (0-2% CPU), Full Vendors Metadata & Revenue Priority Sync

⚡ CPU Performance Optimization & Vendors Metadata
- Added in-memory hardware serial caching to lib/hardware.js to eliminate repeated sudo/exec calls and stabilize CPU usage
- Populate location, license_key, is_licensed, and activated_at in Supabase vendors table
- Refined calculateRevenues to prioritize primary sales logs and prevent total revenue pumping
- Gracefully suppress log spam for non-existent Supabase schema tables
